method: breaths by loudness (under -18 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 18 of 21 breaks heard

lines.latin: Alma Redemptóris Mater, quæ pérvia cæli porta manes,
lines.english: Loving Mother of the Redeemer, who remainest the open gate of heaven,
and star of the sea,
succour the falling

lines.latin: súrgere qui curat pópulo: Tu quæ genuísti, natúra miránte,
lines.english: people who strive to rise again: thou who, while nature marvelled, didst bring forth
thy holy Creator,

lines.latin: Virgo prius ac postérius, Gabriélis ab ore sumens illud Ave,
lines.english: Virgin before and after, who from the mouth of Gabriel didst receive that Ave,
have mercy on sinners.
The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary.
And she conceived of the Holy Spirit.
Let us pray.

lines.latin: Grátiam tuam quǽsumus, Dómine, méntibus nostris infúnde:
lines.english: Pour forth, we beseech Thee, O Lord, Thy grace into our hearts;

lines.latin: ut qui, ángelo nuntiánte, Christi Fílii tui incarnatiónem cognóvimus;
lines.english: that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ, Thy Son, was made known by the message of an Angel,

lines.latin: per passiónem ejus et crucem, ad resurrectiónis glóriam perducámur.
lines.english: may by His Passion and Cross be brought to the glory of His Resurrection.
Through the same Christ our Lord.
Amen.
After childbirth, O Virgin, thou didst remain inviolate.
O Mother of God, intercede for us.
Let us pray.

lines.latin: Deus, qui salútis ætérnæ, beátæ Maríæ virginitáte fecúnda, humáno géneri prǽmia præstitísti:
lines.english: O God, who by the fruitful virginity of Blessed Mary hast bestowed upon mankind the rewards of eternal salvation;

lines.latin: tríbue, quǽsumus; ut ipsam pro nobis intercédere sentiámus,
lines.english: grant, we beseech Thee, that we may know the help of her intercession,

lines.latin: per quam merúimus auctórem vitæ suscípere, Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum Fílium tuum.
lines.english: through whom we were made worthy to receive the Author of life, our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son.
Amen.
